title: Trăng trên mái
about: Round 33, ke-chuyen-gan ("hãy tiếp tục sáng tác album mới, theo phong cách ambient và dễ ngủ"), for a new album, Những giấc mơ nhỏ: the moon on the roof, A-flat major at 54 bpm with its Lydian D natural (Bb over Ab), a dreamy colour. Its motif steps down the chord, then the same shape lifts onto the D natural; the middle in F minor. Written to sleep to, on the sound the user settled on (ke-chuyen-gan: the piano near, a wide hall, a soft echo): its tune moves by step and stays low, its sentences come back with small changes (each middle section 16 bars, a sentence and its variation), the left hand rocks in eighths through most of it, the climax stays low. An original tune.
